title: Valuation AI Briefing - Tue 24 Nov 2026: ASA on AO-41, Northern Ireland's expert AI declaration, Expert Institute AI rules, Houston Methodist's 3-to-1 AI ROI bar
description: The ASA's practical guide to USPAP Advisory Opinion 41 (tool output is not an assignment result; prompts in the workfile), Northern Ireland's Practice Direction 06/2026 requiring an AI declaration in every expert report from 6 January 2027, Expert Institute's new AI rules for expert witnesses, Houston Methodist's 3-to-1 ROI rule for AI agents and what it means for FMV of AI tools provided to physicians, a busy week for Microsoft and GitHub Copilot governance, and a thin funding week (Alecto, Morgan, Aevius Labs).
